hero.title: Privacy
hero.sub: How TD United Plumbing collects, uses and protects the information you share with us through this website.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: TD United Plumbing ("we", "us") is a plumbing and facility services company based in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, serving Miami-Dade and Broward County. This policy explains how we handle personal information collected through this website.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We only collect the information you choose to send us through our emergency, scheduling and quote forms:
items: Your name, phone number and, when requested, email address.
The service address and details about the job (type of service or emergency, preferred date and time, your message).
Your preferred language, so we can reply in English or Spanish.
after: We do not use our own analytics or advertising cookies, and we do not build profiles of visitors.

sections.title: How we use your information
items: To respond to your request, dispatch a plumber, schedule a visit or prepare a quote.
To send you a confirmation of your request by email or text message.
To contact you about the job you requested.
after: We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information.

sections.title: Text messages (SMS)
paragraphs: If you give us your phone number, we may send you text messages related to your request, such as a confirmation or scheduling updates. Message frequency varies and message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out at any time, or HELP for help.

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Phone numbers and text messaging consent are only shared with the providers that deliver our messages.

sections.title: Service providers
paragraphs: We use trusted providers to run this website and deliver our communications. They only process your information to provide their service to us:
items: Resend — delivers our email notifications and confirmations.
Google reCAPTCHA — protects our forms from spam and abuse.
Google Maps — displays our service area map.
Our website hosting provider — serves this website.

sections.title: Cookies and third-party services
paragraphs: This website does not set its own tracking cookies. However, Google reCAPTCHA and the embedded Google Maps map may set cookies and collect information such as your IP address and browser data. Their use is governed by Google’s own policies.
This site is protected by reCAPTCHA and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

sections.title: How long we keep your information
paragraphs: We keep the information from your request only as long as needed to provide our services, keep business records and meet legal obligations.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information you sent us by contacting us at the phone number below. You can stop text messages at any time by replying STOP.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: This website is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed.
